title: Key Account Impact Merit Badge and Release Bucketizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Executive and strategic accounts continuously request roadmap priority. Current intake methods bias by loudness and sales pressure, causing scope churn and tactical rewrites. Goal: design and implement a lightweight, defensible mechanism that (1) assigns a transparent 'Merit Badge' score to top-account asks based on business impact, implementation effort, and cross-functional risk, and (2) groups approved asks into deterministic 'release buckets' (small/medium/strategic) to guarantee fair runway allocation across cycles. This should reduce ad-hoc escalations, create clear artifacts for commercial negotiations, and enable automated gating rules in the roadmap UI/console.
outcome_metrics: % reduction in ad-hoc executive escalations: target 35%
% of top-account asks placed into release buckets without manual arbitration: target 80%
median time from request to bucket decision: target <= 10 business days
NPS change for top-account PMs: +5 points (qualitative)
number of features re-scoped mid-cycle due to VIP escalations: -50%
comments: 2026-02-12 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff sync with sales ops, CS, and legal. Agreed to limit merit criteria to five fast-to-evaluate signals to avoid long reviews.

2026-02-18 - Marco Ruiz: Draft scoring model posted in Confluence. Signals: ARR exposure, renewal proximity, integration depth, regulatory necessity, engineering effort (T-shirt). Initial weighting proposed: ARR 30%, Renewal 20%, Integration 20%, Reg 20%, Effort -10%.

2026-02-22 - Design review (DES): UX critique - need an explainer modal in Console to surface badge drivers; suggested microcopy to avoid perception of 'pay-to-priority'. Action: DES to prototype by 2026-03-05.

2026-03-01 - Eng feedback (ENG-8420): Implementation trade-off - we can reuse existing intake form and add computed badge, but to automate bucket assignment we need a small rules engine. Estimated 2 sprint lift + 1 infra spike for rate-limited evaluation. Added to ENG backlog.

2026-03-04 - Legal note: Ensure badge metadata is not customer-facing CSV that exposes other customers' relative rank. Recommendation: show drivers and badge tier, not percentile score. Marked security_review_required=false for now; revisit if we expose comparative metrics.

2026-03-08 - PM stakeholder review: Sales Ops requested an override path for Strategic bucket with audit trail. Decided: allow manual override with mandatory reason and CSM approval; overrides count toward a monthly quota. Will track as product telemetry.
2026-03-10 - Prototype link shared: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PrototypeExample. Feedback: legal approves wording; CS requests a CSV export for account review board—added as follow-up spike.

2026-03-12 - Decision log: Finalized badge tiers: Bronze (inform), Silver (consider), Gold (fast-track), Platinum (escalate to exec review). Release buckets mapped as: Bronze->Backlog, Silver->Triage, Gold->Cycle allocation (small/medium), Platinum->Executive backlog with SLA to respond within 5 business days. Next: schedule canary with two strategic customers in Cycle 2026-W13.

2026-03-12 - Action items assigned: Marco -> design rules engine spec (due 2026-03-19); DES (Leah Kim) -> Console explainer modal + badge icons (due 2026-03-19); ENG -> infra spike ticket ENG-8672 (created).
notes: Trade-offs considered: full quantitative model (accurate but high friction) vs heuristics (fast, explainable). We selected heuristics to enable operational velocity.
Monitoring plan: new dashboard panel in Grafana for badge distribution by account tier and override count. Alert if override_rate > 10% per month.
Commercial playbook: CS to include badge snapshot in quarterly business review decks for top accounts to manage expectations.
Rollout plan: pilot with 6 accounts (2 Platinum-worthy nominations) -> evaluate after one cycle -> expand to top 50 accounts.
Edge cases: merger/acquisition accounts and channel partner requests will be routed through a separate intake path; badges ignored until account mapping confirmed.
